summary: A trigger that raises a toast, with a title, an optional description and action, stacked at the bottom of the screen and swiped away.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The button that raises a toast. Each press adds one to the stack.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: A button in the toast, `Undo` usually. Leave it out for none.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the action is pressed. The toast closes either way.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Milliseconds before a toast closes by itself. `0` keeps it open.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many toasts stay visible; older ones wait until there is room.

props.name: triggerTone
props.description: The trigger's color: `danger` when the action it reports destroys something.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the toast and its buttons. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: animated
props.description: Toasts slide in, stack and swipe away. Turn it off for an instant change, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the toasts are portalled. Leave it empty for the document body; set it inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
